newsitem.title: USA: Coast Savings comfortable with estimates.
newsitem.headline: Coast Savings comfortable with estimates.

text.p: Ray Martin, chief executive of Coast Saving Financial Inc, said Tuesday he was comfortable with analysts' earnings estimates of $0.49 a share for the third quarter and $2.01 for the fiscal year.
"I'm very comfortable with the Street's consensus," Martin said at the annual meeting of the Western League of Savings Institutions, held in Santa Barbara.
For the third quarter of 1995, the company reported earnings of $0.44 a share. For the full year, it reported earnings of $1.38.
Martin said mutual funds and insurance products have been very profitable for the company, which has about $8.2 billion in assets.
